name: Text to Sound Studio
summary: Prompt-first sound generation: select model and settings, start a new run directly from the View and play every generated WAV.
help: Prompt-first sound generation. Sound gallery preserves previous runs using view state and saved playback links, displays individual WAV players, synchronized waveform playback cursors, click-to-seek and download buttons. Note: older temporary links can expire; durable archiving needs dataset integration.

inputs.label: Live generation progress
inputs.help: Connect the generator telemetry to display stages and progress while it works.
